newsitem.title: CHINA: Tianjin foreign investment at $1.2 bln in Jan-April.
newsitem.headline: Tianjin foreign investment at $1.2 bln in Jan-April.

text.p: China's northern city of Tianjin attracted $1.2 billion in contracted foreign investment in January-April this year, the China News Service said on Friday.
It said 290 foreign companies made the investment pledges. It did not give comparative figures nor did it provide a total for actual investment.

Tianjin, a major industrial city and port, has a total of 10,787 foreign-funded enterprises. Total contracted investment was $16.8 billion and actual investment reached $6.4 billion, the news service said.
